body.message: We couldn't respond to your request in time. Sorry about that. Please try resubmitting your request and contact us if the problem persists.

source: GitHub GraphQL docs, 'Rate limits and query limits for the GraphQL API': a request over 10 seconds gets 'a timeout response and a message reporting that "We couldn't respond to your request in time"'; 'you may receive either a 502 or 504 status code'. The rest of the message text is constructed
